main.description: Queue a job that applies pending contributions from system identities to the catalogue. Requires admin auth.

limit.description: How many pending contributions the job looks at.

after.description: Resume after this contribution URI. Use the `after` a previous job reported.

writes.description: full writes the game, a verification and a review. game_only writes just the game.

dryRun.description: Report what would be applied without writing anything.
